# Hash-pinned Python tools for the lint job, installed with
# `pip install --require-hashes -r ci-requirements.txt`.
#
# Hashes are the sha256 digests PyPI publishes for each release's
# artifacts (https://pypi.org/pypi/<project>/<version>/json). Wheels for
# CPython 3.9-3.13 on manylinux x86_64 are listed, plus the sdist as a
# fallback, to tolerate the Python version shipped by ubuntu-latest
# changing without notice.
#
# To bump a version: fetch
# https://pypi.org/pypi/<project>/<new-version>/json and replace the
# pins below with the new artifacts' digests.sha256 values.

    --hash=sha256:09e5f29531daab93366bb061e76019d5e91691ef0a40328f04c927387d1d364d
